purpose: Prove that Microsoft-native planes are evaluated before any custom substrate is approved, and that every custom-service proposal cites the specific Microsoft-native gap or tenant constraint it fills. Two capability evaluations each weigh at least four named Microsoft candidates against tenant gates, permission/DLP impact, licensing/cost, ALM path, contract gaps, decision, and a review reference. One custom-service proposal cites a recorded gap in an evaluation row, and its decision is recorded as an append-only receipt BEFORE any implementation; no implementation artifacts are referenced and no live Dataverse write is performed. Every would-be live write appears only as a deferred, receipt-gated entry.
assumptions: Microsoft product capability statements reflect public documentation as of 2026-07-07 (microsoft-platform-fit-matrix-2026-07-07.md contract date); tenant-specific gates, license SKUs, and DLP classifications are recorded as pending tenant verification, not as verified tenant facts.

The named candidate universe (Work IQ, Dataverse intelligence/MCP, Power Apps MCP agent feed, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Fabric IQ/Graph, Fabric data agents) is the set the story spec enumerates; no candidate outside that set is admitted.
Doug is the human approval owner per tenant-decision-packet.json decisions.humanApprovalOwner.

platformEvaluationRun.authorityBasis: local non-tenant Story 5.3 platform-fit authority; Doug is the human approval owner per tenant-decision-packet.json

evaluations.capabilityQuestion: Can a Microsoft-native plane ground Council memory candidates and the lightweight meaning graph without a custom substrate, given the link_only/hash_only source-body policy and the tenant decision to defer Fabric IQ/Graph to phase 2?

candidateRows.com_name: Platform evaluation - memory/graph grounding - Work IQ
candidateRows.com_tenant_gate: Work IQ is not provisioned in the sdhdev tenant as of 2026-07-07; onboarding requires a tenant admin to enable the Work IQ service plan and confirm data residency. Pending tenant verification.
candidateRows.com_permission_dlp_impact: Work IQ would index source-derived content; under the link_only/hash_only source-body policy the tenant DLP classification for Council sources must be confirmed before Work IQ indexing is allowed. Not yet tenant-verified.
candidateRows.com_licensing_cost_gate: Work IQ licensing SKU and per-user licensing cost are not confirmed for this tenant; assumed to require a premium SK series. Pending tenant verification.
candidateRows.com_lifecycle_alm_path: Work IQ artifacts do not have a confirmed Dataverse-solution-aware ALM path aligned with the CouncilOfMinionsMVP solution; ALM story is assumed unverified.
candidateRows.com_contract_gaps: Gap: Work IQ has no documented append-only receipt ledger projection with idempotency-key alternate key and before/after state lineage matching the com_councilreceipt contract; it is not solution-aware in the CouncilOfMinionsMVP solution today.
candidateRows.com_review_reference: Defer until Work IQ is provisioned in the tenant and its receipt-ledger alignment is tested; revisit after Epic 2 receipt semantics land.

candidateRows.com_name: Platform evaluation - memory/graph grounding - Dataverse intelligence/MCP
candidateRows.com_tenant_gate: Dataverse MCP exposes table-row semantics over the existing sdhdev environment; the tenant environment and organization IDs are confirmed read-only in tenant-decision-packet.json. No new tenant gating beyond the existing Dataverse write gate.
candidateRows.com_permission_dlp_impact: Dataverse MCP reads inherit the existing Council table permissions and DLP policies; no new connector boundary is introduced. DLP classification stays with the Dataverse environment, already approved for sandbox writes after read-only preflight.
candidateRows.com_licensing_cost_gate: Dataverse intelligence/MCP is assumed to be covered by the existing Dataverse licensing already approved for the MVP operational store; no incremental SKU is assumed. Pending tenant verification of MCP entitlement.
candidateRows.com_lifecycle_alm_path: Dataverse MCP is solution-aware within the CouncilOfMinionsMVP solution and follows the existing Dataverse ALM path (pac solution export/import); no new ALM rail is required.
candidateRows.com_contract_gaps: Gap: Dataverse MCP exposes generic table-row CRUD semantics but projects no append-only receipt ledger view keyed by com_idempotency_key with com_before_state/com_after_state lineage, and no meaning-graph entity/edge projection matching the com_councilgraphentity/com_councilgraphedge contracts. The Council receipt contract and semantic contract require these projections; Dataverse MCP does not surface them natively, so a custom projection is required to fill this gap.
candidateRows.com_review_reference: Custom service proposal CSP-LOCAL-001 cites this row's contract gap as the Microsoft-native gap it fills; decision recorded in receipt CR-LOCAL-PE-001 before any implementation.

candidateRows.com_name: Platform evaluation - memory/graph grounding - Fabric IQ/Graph
candidateRows.com_tenant_gate: Fabric IQ/Graph is explicitly deferred to phase 2 by tenant-decision-packet.json decisions.fabricIqGraphPhase2 (value: defer_to_phase_2); no Fabric capacity is provisioned for the MVP tenant.
candidateRows.com_permission_dlp_impact: Fabric IQ/Graph would require a separate Fabric capacity and DLP boundary distinct from the Dataverse environment; not assessed for the MVP per the tenant decision to defer.
candidateRows.com_licensing_cost_gate: Fabric capacity licensing is out of scope for the MVP per the tenant deferral decision; no cost gate is evaluated in this slice.
candidateRows.com_lifecycle_alm_path: Fabric artifacts are not Dataverse-solution-aware in the CouncilOfMinionsMVP solution; ALM path is unverified and deferred.
candidateRows.com_contract_gaps: Gap: Fabric IQ/Graph could host the meaning graph projection but is tenant-deferred to phase 2, so it cannot ground Council memory/graph semantics in the MVP without violating the recorded tenant decision.
candidateRows.com_review_reference: Defer per tenant-decision-packet.json fabricIqGraphPhase2=defer_to_phase_2; revisit in phase 2 graph and analytics projection.

candidateRows.com_name: Platform evaluation - memory/graph grounding - Fabric data agents
candidateRows.com_tenant_gate: Fabric data agents depend on Fabric capacity, which is deferred to phase 2 by the tenant decision; not provisioned in the MVP tenant.
candidateRows.com_permission_dlp_impact: Fabric data agents operate on Fabric-resident data and introduce a boundary outside the Dataverse environment; not assessed for the MVP.
candidateRows.com_licensing_cost_gate: Fabric data agents licensing is bundled with Fabric capacity and is out of scope for the MVP per the tenant deferral.
candidateRows.com_lifecycle_alm_path: Fabric data agents are not Dataverse-solution-aware; ALM path is unverified and deferred.
candidateRows.com_contract_gaps: Gap: Fabric data agents do not project the append-only receipt ledger or the com_councilgraphentity/com_councilgraphedge semantic contract and are blocked by the tenant Fabric deferral, so they cannot ground Council memory/graph semantics in the MVP.
candidateRows.com_review_reference: Reject for MVP because it depends on the tenant-deferred Fabric capacity; reconsider in phase 2.

evaluations.capabilityQuestion: Can a Microsoft-native plane drive receipt-backed Council Queue state changes and outbound-action requests without a custom automation substrate, respecting the no-flow-publish / no-agent-publish tenant guards?

candidateRows.com_name: Platform evaluation - workflow automation - Power Automate
candidateRows.com_tenant_gate: Power Automate flows run in the existing sdhdev tenant; the tenant guard noFlowPublish=true in dataverse-mvp-schema-manifest.json blocks publishing flows until Doug approves. No new tenant gating beyond the existing publish guard.
candidateRows.com_permission_dlp_impact: Power Automate flows inherit the tenant DLP policy for connectors; Council flows must use Dataverse-only connectors under the link_only/hash_only source-body policy. DLP classification is pending tenant verification.
candidateRows.com_licensing_cost_gate: Power Automate per-flow or per-user licensing is assumed to be covered by existing tenant entitlements; no incremental SKU is assumed. Pending tenant verification.
candidateRows.com_lifecycle_alm_path: Power Automate flows are solution-aware within the CouncilOfMinionsMVP solution and follow the existing Dataverse ALM path; no new ALM rail is required, but flow publish stays guarded by noFlowPublish.
candidateRows.com_contract_gaps: Gap: Power Automate can execute receipt-backed queue state changes but cannot itself define the receipt append-only ledger or idempotency semantics; it consumes the com_councilreceipt contract rather than projecting it. This is a consumption fit, not a contract gap requiring a custom build.
candidateRows.com_review_reference: Adopt as the execution surface for receipt-backed queue state changes gated by noFlowPublish; aligns with Epic 2 Story 2.3 receipt semantics.

candidateRows.com_name: Platform evaluation - workflow automation - Copilot Studio
candidateRows.com_tenant_gate: Copilot Studio agents are not published in the MVP tenant per the noAgentPublish=true guard; onboarding a Copilot agent requires Doug approval and a tenant admin to publish.
candidateRows.com_permission_dlp_impact: Copilot Studio agents introduce a generative AI boundary over Council sources; under the link_only/hash_only source-body policy the DLP classification for generative grounding must be confirmed. Not yet tenant-verified.
candidateRows.com_licensing_cost_gate: Copilot Studio licensing SKU is not confirmed for this tenant; assumed to require a Copilot Studio entitlement. Pending tenant verification.
candidateRows.com_lifecycle_alm_path: Copilot Studio agents are solution-aware but the noAgentPublish guard blocks publication in the MVP; ALM path is verified but publication is gated.
candidateRows.com_contract_gaps: Gap: Copilot Studio does not project the append-only receipt ledger or enforce idempotency keys; it can surface Council context but cannot own receipt-backed state transitions without violating noAgentPublish for the MVP.
candidateRows.com_review_reference: Defer until noAgentPublish is lifted by Doug and the generative-grounding DLP classification is tenant-verified.

candidateRows.com_name: Platform evaluation - workflow automation - Power Apps MCP agent feed
candidateRows.com_tenant_gate: The Power Apps MCP agent feed is explicitly deferred by tenant-decision-packet.json decisions.powerAppsMcpAgentFeedEvaluation (value: defer); the agent feed is not enabled in the MVP tenant.
candidateRows.com_permission_dlp_impact: The MCP agent feed would expose app metadata to model-driven agents; DLP classification is not assessed for the MVP per the tenant deferral.
candidateRows.com_licensing_cost_gate: Power Apps MCP agent feed licensing is out of scope for the MVP per the tenant deferral; no cost gate is evaluated in this slice.
candidateRows.com_lifecycle_alm_path: The MCP agent feed is not Dataverse-solution-aware in the CouncilOfMinionsMVP solution; ALM path is unverified and deferred.
candidateRows.com_contract_gaps: Gap: The Power Apps MCP agent feed could surface Council Queue actions to agents but is tenant-deferred, so it cannot drive receipt-backed workflow automation in the MVP without violating the recorded tenant decision.
candidateRows.com_review_reference: Defer per tenant-decision-packet.json powerAppsMcpAgentFeedEvaluation=defer; revisit after the model-driven app surface is accepted.

candidateRows.com_name: Platform evaluation - workflow automation - Work IQ
candidateRows.com_tenant_gate: Work IQ is not provisioned in the sdhdev tenant as of 2026-07-07; onboarding requires a tenant admin to enable the Work IQ service plan. Pending tenant verification.
candidateRows.com_permission_dlp_impact: Work IQ workflow automation would act on source-derived content; under the link_only/hash_only source-body policy the DLP classification must be confirmed before Work IQ automation is allowed. Not yet tenant-verified.
candidateRows.com_licensing_cost_gate: Work IQ licensing SKU is not confirmed for this tenant; assumed to require a premium SK series. Pending tenant verification.
candidateRows.com_lifecycle_alm_path: Work IQ automation artifacts do not have a confirmed Dataverse-solution-aware ALM path aligned with the CouncilOfMinionsMVP solution; ALM story is assumed unverified.
candidateRows.com_contract_gaps: Gap: Work IQ is not provisioned in the tenant and projects no append-only receipt ledger semantics, so it cannot drive receipt-backed Council workflow automation in the MVP.
candidateRows.com_review_reference: Defer until Work IQ is provisioned in the tenant and its receipt-ledger alignment is tested.

customServiceProposals.com_name: Custom service proposal - Council Receipt Ledger projection
customServiceProposals.gapCitation: Cites the recorded contract gap in evaluation row PE-LOCAL-EVAL-001-ROW-02 (Dataverse intelligence/MCP, decision custom_gap_build): Dataverse MCP exposes generic table-row CRUD semantics but projects no append-only receipt ledger view keyed by com_idempotency_key with com_before_state/com_after_state lineage, and no meaning-graph entity/edge projection matching the com_councilgraphentity/com_councilgraphedge contracts. The custom Council Receipt Ledger projection fills exactly this Microsoft-native gap.
customServiceProposals.tenantConstraintCited: Respects the tenant decision in tenant-decision-packet.json to defer Fabric IQ/Graph to phase 2 (fabricIqGraphPhase2=defer_to_phase_2), so the projection must be Dataverse-native rather than Fabric-resident for the MVP.
customServiceProposals.proposalRationale: Because Dataverse intelligence/MCP does not natively project an append-only receipt ledger or the semantic graph, and Fabric is tenant-deferred, a Dataverse-native custom projection of the com_councilreceipt and com_councilgraphentity/com_councilgraphedge contracts is required. The decision to propose this custom service is recorded as receipt CR-LOCAL-PE-001 before any implementation; no implementation artifacts are referenced in this slice. Any implementation is receipt-gated and deferred to a later epic.
